subject: NorthStar renewal: usage readout & path to commit
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Charlotte Park <charlotte.park@northstar.ai>, Simon Lee <simon.lee@northstar.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: NorthStar renewal: usage readout & path to commit

Hi Charlotte / Simon,

Heading into your November renewal, I pulled a short usage readout and a couple of options that would reduce your unit economics while covering the recent uptick. Attached: Q3 usage summary and an ROI model (high-level). Key signals:

- Current average monthly token usage: ~85M tokens (past 90 days)
- Month-over-month growth: ~12% for the last three months driven by new recommendation pipelines
- Current committed baseline: 60M tokens/month; overages averaging ~25M/month (billable at list)

Two quick paths to consider:
1) 12-month commit (150M tokens/month) with tiered pricing → ~18% reduction to your blended unit cost and predictable headroom for the next 3 quarters.
2) 6-month stepped-commit + burst credits → reduces near-term spend volatility and lets us revisit after the product launch in Q1.

Operational note: Marissa flagged that your peak inference windows are spiky (10–15% of traffic) — if you prefer, we can map a Dedicated capacity corridor to smoother the tail latency and reduce transient cost.

Can we book a 30-minute readout this week to walk the numbers and pick a path? Suggested times: Thu 10/21 10:00–11:30 PT or Fri 10/22 9:00–11:00 PT. If you prefer, I can share an initial proposed term sheet ahead of the meeting (attached draft).

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: northstar_q3_usage_summary.pdf, roi-model_v2.xlsx, proposed_term_sheet.pdf

From: Charlotte Park <charlotte.park@northstar.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Simon Lee <simon.lee@northstar.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T13:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthStar renewal: usage readout & path to commit

Thanks Alex — the summary is helpful. A few quick questions before we meet:

1) Can you break the 85M/month down by environment (prod vs. staging) and by route? We want to identify what’s driving the growth.
2) For the 12-month commit, what is the exact blended per-token price and the overage rate if we exceed the commit?
3) Security/procurement will need a simple list of what logs/metrics Redwood retains and for how long (SOC2 evidence).

We can do Thu 10/21 at 10:30 PT — that works for Simon and me. Please include anyone from your side who can speak to latency SLAs and Dedicated sizing.

-Charlotte
Charlotte Park
Head of Engineering, NorthStar AI
charlotte.park@northstar.ai

Thanks Charlotte — great questions. Quick answers and what I’ll bring to the call: 

- Environment split: prod = ~78% of tokens, staging/qa = ~12%, internal experiments = ~10% — I’ll include a month-by-month CSV on the call.
- Pricing: proposed blended price for 12-month/150M commit = $0.000045/token; overage = $0.000065/token (we can show modeled monthly invoices in the ROI sheet).
- Security retention: Redwood retains request logs (non-PII) for 90 days by default; audit logs and admin access logs are retained 1 year. We’ll attach the SOC2 extract and a short evidence checklist for procurement.

Operational owner: cc’ing Marissa to cover Dedicated sizing and latency corridor recommendations. Vivek (sales manager) is looped to help expedite procurement/term approvals.

I’ve re-attached the ROI model and added a small sensitivity tab showing spend vs. commit for 6/12 month options. See attachments.

I’ll send a calendar invite for Thu 10/21 10:30 PT. Agenda: 1) usage drivers (5–10m) 2) pricing scenarios & ROI (10–15m) 3) ops sizing & SLA (10–15m) 4) next steps + procurement timeline (5m).

Cheers,
Alex
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

> Thanks — joining now.

Quick ops notes from my side (based on your usage spike):
- Peak windows: 09:30–11:00 PT and 18:00–19:30 PT. 95th percentile latency is within SLA today but we see 10–15% tail latency increases during bursts.
- Dedicated corridor recommendation: reserve a small Dedicated pool sized for the 95th percentile baseline and keep a burst policy enabled (burst credits for irregular spikes). This reduces token waste from timeouts or retries and stabilizes p99 latency.
- Migration: if you opt for Dedicated, we can do a phased roll (canary on next deploy) — estimated ops lift: 2 engineer-days initial, then 0.5 engineer-days/week for monitoring for first 4 weeks.

I’ll follow up with a short ops checklist and a Dedicated sizing diagram after the call.

—Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Charlotte Park <charlotte.park@northstar.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Simon Lee <simon.lee@northstar.ai>
Date: 2026-10-21T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthStar renewal: usage readout & path to commit

Appreciate the readout and the clear options. After discussing internally, NorthStar is inclined toward the 12-month commit to stabilize costs in light of the upcoming product launch, but we have two asks before we can commit:

1) Can Redwood provide a short written addendum that caps overage at a maximum blended uplift (e.g., no more than +30% over the committed rate for the first quarter) while we normalize traffic post-launch?
2) Procurement needs the SOC2 extract + log retention statement (the checklist you mentioned).

If you can send the addendum and SOC2 evidence by EOD Thu 10/22, I’ll escalate and aim to sign the term sheet by next week. Please cc your legal or contracts person on the term sheet when you send it.

Thanks — Charlotte
